PROJECT_TITLE.value: Class A GPCR Structure–Ligand Contact and Interface Atlas
PROJECT_TITLE.note: Current artefacts use 'Class A GPCR Atlas' (release_metadata.json, references.json).

SHORT_NAME.note: The suggested 'Class A GPCR Structural Pharmacology Atlas' asserts pharmacology content the atlas does not contain. functional_pathway_evidence is null for all 1358 structures (SD-04); GtoPdb, ChEMBL and PubChem are never called; there is no potency, affinity, efficacy or agonist/antagonist activity data. Ligand ROLE annotations (orthosteric/allosteric/PAM/NAM) are present but are source-relayed binding-mode classifications, not measured pharmacology.
SHORT_NAME.decision_note: Overclaim flag cleared: the name no longer asserts pharmacology content the atlas lacks.

DERIVED_DATA_REVIEW_STATUS.decision_note: The packet in docs/DERIVED_DATA_REVIEW_PACKET.md is the material for this decision and the copyright holder is the one who takes it. The open item is the share-alike question in §3, not a review queue.

SHARE_ALIKE_REVIEW_STATUS.note: GtoPdb, ChEMBL, PubChem and UniChem are called by pipeline/enrichment/fetch_chemical_xrefs.py and their responses are cached under data/cache/, which is not published. What the release carries from them is the identifier, the link, the retrieval date and the basis on which the match was made — facts about which entry corresponds to which component, not content. The preferred compound name each source publishes is no longer carried. Component name, formula and InChIKey come from the RCSB chemical component dictionary.
SHARE_ALIKE_REVIEW_STATUS.decision_note: Closed by removing the names rather than by arguing about them. The interface shows the identifier and links to the page where the source publishes the name.

DOI_POLICY.note: No DOI exists. Absence is enforced by rc_integrity_tests.py.
DOI_POLICY.decision_note: Zenodo archives every published release. The concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21901790 resolves to the most recent release and is what CITATION.cff carries; each release also has a version DOI, 0.1.0-beta.2 being 10.5281/zenodo.21901791. A DOI on a pre-release cites what was published at that point and is not a claim that the release is curated or independently validated; the citation file says so.

STABLE_CURATED_RELEASE_GATE.decision_note: 0.1.0-beta.1 may be published. v1.0.0, 'fully curated' and 'independently validated across Class A' may not be claimed.

LICENCE_TEXT_INTEGRITY.decision_note: An earlier draft embedded scope commentary inside LICENSE ahead of the PolyForm text. PolyForm requires the terms (or their URL) and the Required Notice lines to travel with copies; mixing project commentary into the licence body makes it unclear which text is the licence. LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA are now byte-identical to the retrieved official texts, and all scope moved to LICENSE-NOTICE.md and LICENSE-SCOPE.json.
